AlarmDescription: Alert 5 of 6. Deleted photos and avatars may still be public: for the whole last hour at least one media cleanup row kept failing (dari.media.cleanup_failures > 0), or at least one row is DEAD (the worker gave up; in S3 mode the object may still be readable). Evaluated every minute over a sliding hour. Runbook: docs/PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS.md, Monitoring > First response > Storage failing, and Dead media cleanup rows.

Metrics.Label: Lowest count of failing cleanup rows in the last hour
Highest DEAD cleanup count in the last hour
1 when cleanup failed for a whole hour or any row is DEAD
